messages.author: 4be88a5fc86a040f
messages.subject: Re: make checkboxGroupInput appears horizontally?
parts:
Use CSS tags (create overrides.css file, place it in your www folder and reference it with tags$head)

ui.r:
...
sidebarPanel(

tags$head(tags$link(rel="stylesheet", type="text/css", href="overrides.css")),

checkboxGroupInput("myGroup", "", c("a", "b", "c", "d"))
),
...

overrides.css
#myGroup>*{

     float: left;

     margin-right: 15px;

     height: 20px;

}

#myGroup{

     height: 20px;

}
----
Funny thing, when I am using the tags$style to do it, the function replaces ">" in "#myGroup>*" with "&gt" and nothing works.
